IC1: Highly active RMS as defined by:
IC2: One relapse in the previous year and at least 1 T1 Gadolinium (Gd)+ lesion [OR] or 9 or more T2 lesions, while on therapy [AND] with other disease modifying drugs (DMDs)
IC3: Two or more relapses in the previous year, whether on DMD treatment or not.
IC4: Expanded Disability Status Scale (EDSS) score less than equals to (<=) 5.0.
IC5: Other protocol defined inclusion criteria could apply.
